input.summary: Use the right flipper to hit Satisfaction and collect bonus at the upper-left saucer. Feed the top to complete R-O-C-K and raise Bonus X. Complete 1-2-3-4-5 for held Super Bonus, then repeat the saucer after the combined value is large.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each R-O-C-K completion advances the multiplier through 2x, 3x, and 5x.

quickInfo.name: Satisfaction
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left standup lights the nearby saucer to collect standard and Super Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Super Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Three complete 1-2-3-4-5 sets build the value through 20,000, 40,000, and 60,000.

quickInfo.name: Number 5 relight
quickInfo.summary: The horseshoe post briefly lights target 5 so its next hit spots one missing R-O-C-K letter.

quickInfo.name: Maximum collect
quickInfo.summary: A 19,000 standard bonus plus 60,000 Super Bonus at 5x pays 395,000 at the saucer.

steps.text: Read the lit R-O-C-K letters and check whether progress holds after the first drain.
modeNotes: Check whether R-O-C-K, number-set, and lit Extra Ball progress carry between balls.

steps.text: Control on the right flipper, hit the Satisfaction target, and confirm that the upper-left saucer lights.
Shoot the lit saucer to collect the current standard bonus and Super Bonus.
modeNotes: Satisfaction: Its standup scores 5,000, adds three bonus advances, and lights the saucer for the combined collect.

steps.text: Use the saucer eject to return toward the top lanes and collect missing R-O-C-K letters.
Complete R-O-C-K for 2x, then repeat the top-feed sequence for 3x and 5x.
modeNotes: Bonus X: The four top lanes have no lane change; a lit target 5 can spot one missing letter.

steps.text: Complete 1-2-3-4-5 during safe feeds to build Super Bonus from 20,000 to 40,000, then 60,000.
modeNotes: Super Bonus: The first three full number sets store 20,000, 40,000, and 60,000 for the saucer and drain payout.

steps.text: Hit Satisfaction again when required and collect the larger combined bonus at the saucer.
A second saucer collect on the same ball can award Extra Ball; stop when settings make it worthless or the entry becomes unsafe.
Protect held Super Bonus and multiplier progress from a tilt.

fallback.title: Recovery: Numbered targets and Super Bonus
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when Satisfaction or the saucer is unreliable.

steps.text: From the left flipper, shoot targets 3 or 4.
Use useful rebounds into the bumpers to collect targets 1 and 2.
Use the right flipper for target 5.
Complete 1-2-3-4-5 for 20,000 Super Bonus.
Repeat the number set for 40,000 and 60,000.
Return to the saucer only after control improves.

alternatives.title: Position play: R-O-C-K and multiplier
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when controlled top feeds are more reliable than the saucer.

steps.text: Feed the ball to the top lanes and collect unlit R-O-C-K letters.
Hit the horseshoe post to relight target 5, then use target 5 to spot a missing letter.
Complete R-O-C-K for 2x, 3x, and 5x.
A later completion at 5x awards Special or its tournament points.

alternatives.title: Right drop-bank award
alternatives.when: Use this when the rotating award is valuable and the bank return is controlled.

steps.text: Read the rotating 5,000 through 25,000 or Special award.
Complete the number targets but leave one when the selected award is weak.
Finish the bank when the desired award is lit.
Use held partial bank progress after a drain when the setting permits it.
Complete R-O-C-K three times and reach 5x Bonus X.
Complete 1-2-3-4-5 three times for 60,000 Super Bonus.
Hit Satisfaction and shoot either horseshoe until standard bonus reaches 19,000.
Hit Satisfaction and shoot the lit upper-left saucer.
Collect 395,000; a second same-ball collect can also award Extra Ball.

checkBeforePlay: Check whether R-O-C-K, number-set, and lit Extra Ball progress carry between balls.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus collect saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-left saucer used to collect base bonus and Super Bonus.
playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the saucer after building a worthwhile combined bonus.

techniques.name: Right-flipper saucer route
techniques.instruction: Use the right flipper for Satisfaction and the upper-left saucer; its eject feeds the top lanes.

techniques.name: Left-flipper number feed
techniques.instruction: Shoot targets 3 or 4 from the left flipper and use a controlled bumper rebound for targets 1 or 2.

techniques.name: Number 5 relight
techniques.instruction: Hit the small horseshoe post, then hit target 5 before its lamp expires to spot R-O-C-K.

cautions.response: Use that area for number progress only when both side lanes are acceptable.

cautions.issue: The Satisfaction target can rebound toward the center or slings.
cautions.response: Shoot it only from a controlled right-flipper position.

cautions.issue: Target 5 can return dangerously and horseshoe misses can graze the slings.
cautions.response: Use target 5 only when lit for R-O-C-K help and stop the horseshoe after one bad miss.

cautions.issue: A tilt erases a combined bonus that can reach 395,000.
cautions.response: Use small, early nudges after standard bonus, Super Bonus, and Bonus X are built.

input.simpleOverview: Rolling Stones is a bonus-building and saucer-collect game. Complete R-O-C-K to raise Bonus X, complete 1-2-3-4-5 to raise held Super Bonus, hit Satisfaction, then shoot the lit upper-left saucer for the combined collect.
input.overview: Rolling Stones is a bonus-building and saucer-collect game. Use the saucer eject to return to the top letters, build toward 5x and 60,000 Super Bonus, then hit Satisfaction and collect. Protect held progress from a tilt.
